review.authority: User requested correction of the preceding full reference review; regional Python/Pillow compositing authorization is retained from issue 396.
checks: Inspected current full sheet and enlarged before/after crops for the requested correction, identity, proportions, occlusion and smooth patch boundaries.
Confirmed unchanged canvas/mode and zero changed pixels outside the current edit mask; retained prior regional correction provenance.
Static reference acceptance only; existing animation clips and device rendering were not validated.
limits: Hidden surfaces and fittings are conservative generated interpretations, not surveyed 3D geometry.
Side views are oblique/profile references, not calibrated orthographic projections.
Static reference review does not prove frame-to-frame animation stability; use canonical measurements to correct generated drift.
corrections: Tail starts at the same centered low rear-pelvis attachment in seated and standing poses, then curls to anatomical left (screen right in front, screen left in rear). Side views retain a narrower foreshortened hook and visible air gap from the back; do not flatten the curl onto the torso.
Seated wheel-holding rear view retains only narrow upper-arm edges below the head; forward hands and feet are occluded by the torso. Do not widen the torso to hide limbs.
Seated and standing side tail tips are free from the back, with an open background gap; the existing low root, overall silhouette and equipment remain in place.

compositing.method: Original pixels with reviewed image_gen patches; neutral background matched locally

previous_revision.method: Original RGB plus reviewed generated patches

identity_constraints: Thick dark navy rounded trapezoid frames and dark smoky blue lenses.
One pale cyan five-point star at each outer FRONT frame corner.
Curved temples, short bridge; no enclosing strap, cap, sprout or gold rims.

fit: Lenses cover both eyes at eye line, never rest on forehead.
Bridge centers above w-shaped mouth; mouth and exposed whisker marks remain visible.
Temples continue backward along head sides and become occluded; no band spans rear head.
Rear worn view contains no lenses or face; only temple tips where visible.
occlusion: Front frame/lenses in front of eyes.
Temple arms behind side silhouette/ear base where occluded; no rear-spanning strap.
attachment_contract.transform: Rigidly follow skull translation/rotation at the canonical relative scale. No independent floating, stretching or per-frame fit-to-bounds.

generation_gate.on_missing_or_hash_mismatch: Stop generation and resolve missing/unreviewed references; do not invent a replacement.
generation_gate.pose_selection: Seated wheel-holding idle and empty-handed standing use the same fitted item geometry and skull attachment.
generation_gate.runtime_boundary: Reference-only files under art. No runtime resource replacement or automatic image-path loading is introduced.
